scripts.build: npm run quality && npm run build:site
scripts.build:production: npm run content:sync && npm run verify:publication && npm run build:production-content -w @amaral.codes/website
scripts.content:dev: npm run content:sync && npm run dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:production && npm run verify:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config packages/website/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:dry-run: npm run build:production && npm run verify:cloudflare
scripts.quality:hygiene: eslint --max-warnings 0 scripts && node --test scripts/architecture-rules/index.test.mjs scripts/content-asset-hygiene/index.test.mjs scripts/module-structure/index.test.mjs scripts/presentation-asset-hygiene/index.test.mjs scripts/public-content-privacy/index.test.mjs scripts/public-markdown-html/index.test.mjs scripts/publication-snapshot/index.test.mjs scripts/release-safety/index.test.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-module-structure.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-repository-hygiene.mjs && npm run verify:content && node scripts/release-safety/index.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run quality:hygiene && npm run quality:contract && npm run quality:content && npm run quality:website && npm run quality:cms
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser -w @amaral.codes/website && npm run test:browser -w @amaral.codes/cms
scripts.verify:cloudflare: npm run verify:release:safety && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config packages/website/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.verify:content: node scripts/commands/check-public-content.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-public-markdown-html.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-content-assets.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-presentation-assets.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run quality && npm run verify:assets && npm run build:site && npm run verify:cloudflare && npm run test:browser && npm run perf:ci && npm audit --audit-level=high
